title: Declare PluginProcessor header APVTS and FIFO
description:
Rewrite Source/PluginProcessor.h (phase-a stub re-author; single owner in this phase) as the PluginProcessor class header for APVTS + DSP integration.

Header must declare:
- juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState (APVTS) member and static/createParameterLayout declaration
- owned DSP instances: SonicMaximizer, AuralExciter, RoutingEngine
- lock-free SPSC audio-to-UI spectrum transfer: juce::AbstractFifo + std::array<float, N> (N sized for spectrum frames)
- latency state members used with setLatencySamples based on oversampling
- prepareToPlay / processBlock / releaseResources (and related) signatures matching the JUCE AudioProcessor contract used by this project
- atomic/SmoothedValue parameter handles or raw atomic pointers as needed by the .cpp (declare only; no bodies)
- createEditor still returning the generic/editor stub path (do not declare real custom editor wiring beyond existing JUCE signatures)

Include what exists for DSP headers (SonicMaximizer, AuralExciter, RoutingEngine) and JUCE modules already used by the phase-a stub. Prefer forward declares only where the existing style already does; keep includes minimal and consistent with neighboring Source headers.

Do NOT implement .cpp bodies here. Do NOT modify PluginEditor.* or any DSP .cpp.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h (phase-a stub)
- Source/PluginProcessor.cpp (phase-a stub signatures only; do not write this file)
- Source headers for SonicMaximizer, AuralExciter, RoutingEngine
- CMakeLists.txt / target name AuralMaximizerPro_Standalone
- Any parameter-spec or design doc under docs/ that lists the 19 APVTS parameter IDs

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginProcessor.h exists and declares APVTS member and createParameterLayout
Source/PluginProcessor.h declares owned SonicMaximizer, AuralExciter, and RoutingEngine members
Source/PluginProcessor.h declares lock-free SPSC spectrum FIFO via juce::AbstractFifo and std::array<float, N>
Source/PluginProcessor.h declares prepareToPlay/processBlock signatures and latency-related state
cmake --build cmake-build-debug --target AuralMaximizerPro_Standalone succeeds after this header change (may still use prior .cpp stub)
cppcheck --enable=all Source/PluginProcessor.h reports no error-level issues blocking the build
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify any DSP implementation under Source/
wire a real custom PluginEditor in createEditor
use heap allocation or locks on the declared audio-path API surface

allowed: re-author phase-a PluginProcessor.h stub with APVTS/DSP/FIFO/latency declarations
choose N for spectrum std::array consistent with existing spectrum frame size
match existing JUCE AudioProcessor subclass naming in the repo
forbidden: implement processBlock or createParameterLayout bodies in the header
introduce a second parameter system outside APVTS
change plugin format targets or CMake layout
